direct_publication_refusal: PublicationPrepared and PublicationUnknown both accept a verified publication refusal. Retain inert local draft custody and record Refused without advancing canonical selection.
historical_publication: Verified CanonicalPublished and SourceTransitionPending records remain reconcilable even when the current cut changes. Reconcile the original snapshot and selector history. If superseded, record the later selector as an observation and retain the historical publication receipt. Never republish the old snapshot merely to finish reconciliation.
terminal_authority: The original terminal journal receipt binds run, workspace, original operation, keys, final revision, published snapshot and observed source transition. Committed/Replayed native and publication outcomes must agree. Invalid or contradictory terminal inputs produce InvalidEvidence and read-only journal inspection.
persistence: Append the verified event, update the phase and revision, and create the immutable command receipt atomically. Exact repeats replay the original result. A changed command tuple at the same revision conflicts.
projection: The issuance selection binds every transition input and observed member to the complete original past fact. The pure operation validates correlation, allowed outcome and graph edge.
effects: Source reconciliation after canonical publication records observation and reader adoption of the already admitted snapshot.
